# Kubernetes specialist (Jeffallan)

Writes and debugs Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, RBAC and network policies.

- Source: https://github.com/Jeffallan/claude-skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jeffallan/claude-skills/main/skills/kubernetes-specialist/SKILL.md
- Author: Jeffallan
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/kubernetes-specialist-jeffallan-fad9448b

Guides Claude through Kubernetes work: deployments, services and ingress, config and secrets, storage, Helm charts and troubleshooting. Its rules require resource requests and limits, health probes, least-privilege RBAC and NetworkPolicies, and it lists kubectl commands for checking rollouts and rolling back. Reference files cover operators, service mesh, GitOps with Argo CD or Flux, cost tuning and multi-cluster setups.

**Try asking:**
- "Write a Deployment and Service for this API with probes and resource limits"
- "My pod is in CrashLoopBackOff. Help me debug it"
- "Add a default-deny NetworkPolicy and allow only the frontend to reach the API"
